feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi kumpirmado ang halaman sa bakuran, at buto ang nakalista sa card, hindi anumang bahagi.
feedback_by_option.en: The yard plant is not confirmed, and the card lists seeds, not any part.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama: buto ng Quisqualis indica ang nakalista sa card. Hindi ito dose para sa bata.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct: the card lists seeds of Quisqualis indica. This is not a dose for the child.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi patunay ng halaman ang local name; tingnan ang botanical name sa card.
feedback_by_option.en: A local name does not confirm the plant; check the botanical name on the card.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi kumpirmado ang halaman, at makapipinsala sa bata ang maling halaman o dami ng buto.
feedback_by_option.en: The yard plant is not confirmed, and a wrong plant or seed amount can harm a child.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag magbigay ng buto sa bata batay sa lumang table; walang dose na awtorisado sa lesson na ito.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not give seeds to a child from the old manual's table; this lesson authorizes no dose.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama: hindi pa kumpirmado ang bulate. Sa health center ang diagnosis at deworming plan.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct: worms are not yet confirmed. The health center diagnoses and plans deworming.
